title: Bad Eden: Epic Play
description: Epic-tier capstone for Bad Eden (RFI fourththing only). P1 — The Gate: per-Steward Convergence detection (Tier-5 band + enlightenment apex), the 'mojo returns' beat, sheet readout, and the bbttcc:epic:converged hook. Later phases add Presence, World-Health, the Adversary Response, and Crown/Thaumiel capstones.
